desc: Pack all the features and upgrades you expect from a Savage precision rifle into a single platform and you have the MSR 10 Long Range. It is built on a compact frame with a non-reciprocating side-charging handle. Its two-stage target trigger and Magpul PRS adjustable buttstock optimize the inherent accuracy of the upgraded Savage barrel , which features 5R rifling and a Melonite QPQ finish.
